items.followUp: What is meant by the least count of a measuring instrument?

rubric.why: Significant figures include all the certain digits in a measurement.
rubric.description: Identifies the certain digits as part of significant figures.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that significant figures include the certain digits.

rubric.why: The final significant figure is the first uncertain or doubtful digit.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the first uncertain or doubtful digit is included.

modelAnswer: Significant figures in a measurement are all the certain digits plus the first uncertain (doubtful) digit.

items.followUp: Differentiate between uniform and non-uniform acceleration.

rubric.why: In the stated Class 9 definition, positive acceleration is associated with an increase in velocity.
rubric.description: States that positive acceleration occurs when velocity or speed increases with time.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly describing positive acceleration.

rubric.why: Negative acceleration is associated with a decrease in velocity.
rubric.description: States that negative acceleration occurs when velocity or speed decreases with time.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for correctly describing negative acceleration.

modelAnswer: Positive acceleration occurs when the velocity of a body increases with time.
Negative acceleration occurs when the velocity of a body decreases with time.

items.followUp: Write any two advantages of friction.

rubric.why: Friction causes surfaces in contact to wear down.
rubric.description: Gives wear and tear of surfaces as a disadvantage of friction.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for one valid disadvantage.

rubric.why: Friction can convert useful energy into unwanted heat and reduce machine efficiency.
rubric.description: Gives heat production, energy loss, or reduced efficiency as a distinct disadvantage.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for a second valid disadvantage, distinct from wear and tear.

modelAnswer: Friction causes wear and tear of surfaces in contact.
Friction produces unwanted heat, wasting energy and reducing the efficiency of machines.
